headline: Algorithmic breakthroughs in quantum dynamics and complexity
summary: Today's research features powerful new algorithmic and analytic tools spanning quantum information, open systems, and theoretical computer science. Highlights include polynomial-time reductions for long-standing algebraic conjectures, novel quantum speed limits, and efficient transforms.

themes.title: Quantum Foundations and Entropy
themes.body: Exploring fundamental limits and structural properties in quantum systems, including entropy contraction without detailed balance, odd-prime generalizations of magic squares, and non-Markovian quantum speed limits.

themes.title: Algorithms and Quantum Control
themes.body: Delivering efficient computational methods and control techniques, such as a polynomial-time algorithm for Marton's conjecture, analytic leakage suppression for quantum gates, and adaptive quantum Hermite transforms.

connections.body: Both papers advance quantum information theory through analytic bounds and operator-level techniques, addressing fundamental limits in open systems and quantum channel entropy.
